validation.protocol: Raw teacher-forced predictions; episode-local nonoverlapping prefixes; each valid action once; training episodes measure fitting only.
validation.baseline_contract: Hold uses observed pose/joints and gripper at the inference anchor; persistence repeats the prior achieved delta/recorded target and holds the anchor gripper. Tool deltas are transported between observed tool frames. Neither uses future observations.
validation.geometry_caution: Cartesian metrics inherit the prepared FK calibration; joint metrics are degrees, not Cartesian task error.

offline_selection.weights: equal mean of available components; thresholds fixed before training
offline_selection.scope: offline shortlist only; same split, targets, normalization and component availability required for comparison
offline_selection.promotion: requires bounded common development rollouts, then frozen reserved evaluation; offline score establishes no task success

localization.interpretation: Pseudo detector agreement and input sensitivity; not annotation accuracy or causal task success. Swapping only predicted centers deliberately breaks image-feature consistency.

limitations: One seed, small new bottleneck architecture and fixed pseudo-label detector. Uses unchanged provisional FK targets and bounded training subset. Independent object localization, geometric metrology and task success are not established.
intervention_caution: Single-input counterfactuals intentionally break image/keypoint consistency and have no measured action labels. They assess dependence, not counterfactual prediction accuracy or task success.
conclusion: Auxiliary supervision learns pseudo ball localization but does not improve action error. The action head remains weakly sensitive to image keypoints. This separates a usable image-localization representation from a policy that uses object location correctly.
sampling_contract: Identical seed0 with-replacement minibatch draws from the fixed1,024-observation training cache; only1,010 distinct observations were drawn.

random_frame_model_agreement.caution: Agreement between learned pseudo-label center and independently pretrained detector-prompted visible-mask centroid on preselected frames, not physical calibration or localization ground truth. Definitions differ under occlusion. Localization head does not use proprioception; zero state used only to call model interface.
